findings.summary: build_features standardizes using the mean/std of the DataFrame it receives, so test-set statistics leak into training (optimistic AUC) and scaling at prediction time depends on the batch, giving the same customer different features across batches.
The standardization division has no guard for zero or NaN std (constant column or single row), producing NaN features that make LogisticRegression raise a ValueError in fit and predict_proba.
